resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS says the cabin was built in the late 1920s, and firelookout.com dates the platform atop the frame cabin to the 1930s. The platform and the cabin may have different dates. The story reports both without choosing.
Firelookout.com lists emergency use in the 1960s and the site as gone; FFLOS says it was gone by the 1970s. These do not contradict each other, so the story gives both.

notes_for_editor: Only three pages, and they say little about the cabin's history: no year is given for its removal and no source names a lookout. FFLOS gives 4,500 ft (1,372 m) and firelookout.com gives 4480 ft; the record's 1371.6 m is kept. Photo credits on firelookout.com go to the Howard Verschoor collection and Harold C. Chriswell, and the FFLOS photos are 'View of site' and 'Remains of cabin foundation'; no image URLs were captured, so no photos are listed. A 2023 blog post (cherylhill.net, 'Red Hill') describes a different standing Red Hill lookout with a 40-foot L-4 tower built in 1947 and was not used here. The story's remains sentence rests on an undated caption.
